verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is documented as a way to automate and execute workflows in your repository, backed by CI/CD. The Copilot cloud agent takes assigned tasks and runs them in GitHub-hosted sandboxes "without using your machine," moving from issue to pull request, with a central page for tracking agent sessions. Together these cover setting up automations that run in the background. missing for 10: documented event or schedule triggers for unattended runs (Actions evidence is only a one-line summary), evidence that agent tasks can start automatically without manual assignment, independent hands-on corroboration.
